scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json && esbuild script.ts startup.ts --bundle --minify --platform=browser --format=iife --outdir=dist/browser
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm test && node --import tsx tests/ci.mts
scripts.cf:build: npm run build && mkdir -p cloudflare/public/assets && cp index.html cloudflare/public/index.html && cp style.css cloudflare/public/style.css && cp dist/browser/script.js cloudflare/public/script.js && cp dist/browser/startup.js cloudflare/public/startup.js && cp assets/mock-video.mp4 cloudflare/public/assets/mock-video.mp4
scripts.cf:dev: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler dev --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
